Fuseo's content and method are designed with Dr Jonathan Taieb, sleep physician at the Institut Médical du Sommeil, and Dr Maxime Elbaz, engineer and PhD in neuroscience, former technical director of the Sleep and Alertness Centre at Hôtel-Dieu hospital, Paris.

Fuseo provides general information and advice on sleep and travel chronobiology. The service is not a medical consultation, does not make a diagnosis and does not replace the advice of a healthcare professional.
